metadata.name: Ibarz-Tanaka Rulkov Map
metadata.author: Ibarz, B.; Tanaka, G.; Sanjuan, M.A.F.; Aihara, K.
metadata.description: Self-sustained-oscillation Rulkov map from Ibarz et al. (2007), Eqs. 2-3

dynamics.v: ((-(alpha * alpha) / 4.0 - alpha + I + u) if v < (-1.0 - alpha / 2.0) else (alpha * v + (v + 1.0) * (v + 1.0) + I + u if v <= 0.0 else (1.0 + I + u if v < (1.0 + I + u) else -1.0)))

extensions.source_equation_note: Implements Eqs. 2-3 of DOI 10.1103/PhysRevE.75.041902; beta, a fixed threshold, and a configurable reset are absent from the source model.
extensions.observation_note: An event marks execution of Eq. 3's fourth branch, which resets v to the source-fixed value -1.
extensions.silicon_cosim_note: Q16.16 is required because the source mu=0.001 quantises to zero in Q8.8. At I=0.2 over 30 iterations it preserves the exact three-event vector with v error below 0.003 and u error below 0.0001.
